task/solution/solve.sh, task/solution/app/server.js:140-171, task/solution/app/src/app.tsx:22-40, grep of solution/app/public, index.html, static
evidence: No judge prompt names a fixed sentinel value (no SKU, name or reason literal); every mutation probe is judge-chosen and required to be fresh: e.g. constraints cw_shared_saved_record 'a unique title and a short unique source', functional cw_save_reload_restart 'an exact unique title and filename' plus 'distinctive marker', cw_live_library_update 'a unique title', cw_preview_isolation 'distinctive key and value'/'distinctive hostile marker', cw_dynamic_code_refused payload markers built by joining two halves so the whole marker never appears in source, and functional prompt.md:25 'You may choose the exact fixture text for each criterion. Check that the editor holds it before acting.' The seed is empty (environment/assets/seed_data.json: "snippets": [], sha256 30cf9958...), solve.sh deletes /app/app.db before install, and server.js:142-171 only creates tables (the INSERT OR IGNORE at :167 copies from the empty snippets table); the reference initial UI state is code '', title 'Untitled', filename 'snippet.js' (src/app.tsx:22-26). The only fixed literal a criterion has the judge create is the multi-caret text 'MULTI' (judge.toml cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic); grep finds no 'MULTI' in seed, instructions, solution/app/public, index.html or static, and it is typed into a judge-chosen fixture, so a pre-existing copy could only cause a false fail, not a false pass. app_context.md:26 warns the library may hold earlier records and they are identified by the server, not title, so cross-criterion residue (isolated=false, shared DB, and test.sh:97-109 reusing the agent's /app/app.db) cannot pre-satisfy a judge-chosen unique title. Broken app tried: one that pre-populates its library/preview with plausible titles or markers cannot match values the judge invents at grading time; conforming alternative tried: an app whose leftover dev records or default draft contain arbitrary text is not failed by this row because probes are fresh and negatives (hostile marker absent) only test values the judge created. Manual application of check-probe-not-in-seed.py's documented behaviour (no named sentinels, so it would skip); the private checker itself was not executed. This is a static source property; no configured-judge run exists for v16 bytes (raw-evidence-index scope), but none is needed to decide this row.
